name: keyring-launch-video
description: Renders launch.html and its generated soundtrack into keyring-launch.mp4. npm install, then npm run video (macOS: encodes and muxes with AVFoundation).

scripts.video: node render.mjs && swift encode.swift frames keyring-launch-silent.mp4 && node audio.mjs && swift mux.swift keyring-launch-silent.mp4 keyring-launch.wav keyring-launch.mp4
